requirements: No baked farmstead, tavern, field, greenhouse, bridge, or placeholder structure in the default exterior region
Continuous outdoor surface with no outdoor scene-transition portals

The active certification world uses only the source-pure V7 normalized atlas for grass, dirt, road, sand, banks, paths, rock ground, cave floor, shallows, water, deep water, edges, corners, and junctions
ElizaWy terrain and cliff sheets remain a separate mainland style lane and are not rendered over V7 landmasses
Freshwater follows Dirt_Brown -> Water_Shallows_Dirt -> Water -> Water_Deep
Ocean follows Sand -> Water_Shallows_Sand -> Water -> Water_Deep
Willowmere remains the permanent capital framework while surrounding terrain is seed-driven
Player building is open outside protected city districts; farms are rural and most other businesses use city plots
Reviewed Terrain-folder trees, bushes, rocks, mushrooms, and plants populate the biome through exact source components
Cliff, elevation-ramp, waterfall, flower, wildflower, seasonal tree, and seasonal plant sheets are registered in the Terrain-family authority for editor/worldgen promotion
Runtime terrain is retained on one native-resolution surface and invalidated only by semantic terrain changes
The pure V7 island lane is separately governed by content/worldgen/v7_tile_lane_isolation_contract_v0_1.json and may not reference ElizaWy assets
Non-grass decorative fill alternates are disabled until audited as complete single-cell details; larger authored details place only as atomic objects or stamps
diagnosticPolicy: Focused terrain acceptance scenes remain diagnostics. The default client world is a generated open-world biome region, not a static farmstead board.
previewPolicy: Semantic topology previews are diagnostic colors only. LPC/runtime evidence must use production source pixels; live-client screenshots remain final visual authority.
wetSandPolicy: legacy alias migrates to V7 Sand; no active WetSand brush, band, or transition group
normalizedAtlasPolicy: one source-pure normalized runtime atlas per style lane; no blended global terrain atlas
